header: The three people on a typical engagement
subheadline: Every project runs with one designer, one researcher and one systems engineer from the first interview to the handover. The same three stay the whole way, so nothing gets re-briefed in week nine and the person who drew the screen is the person who explains it.

members.name: Clara Nunes
members.bio: Led the Kestrel Bank onboarding rebuild that took drop-off from 38 per cent to 17. Joined in 2019 from a newsroom design team.

members.name: Inês Duarte
members.bio: Runs the field studies. Spent six weeks riding along in Northwind depots before anyone at the studio opened a drawing file.

members.name: Rafael Lima
members.bio: Maintains the four component libraries we hand to client engineering teams, and writes the handover notes nobody else wants to write.
